title: AGENTS.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 14
summary: Gate contract for subagents: call mcp__orchestrator-graph__branch_task(task_key) first to create an isolated worktree (orch/attempt/<key>), then mcp__orchestrator-graph__start_task(task_key, agent_id). The daemon rejects start_task if no worktree is registered — order is enforced. All file writes must happen inside the worktree; the gate hard-blocks subagent writes on any other branch. ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 as an inline env prefix does not work from subagents — the hook runs as a separate process. Never bypass via workarounds (rsync, fabricated claims, etc.); claim properly.
